decision_notes: The current institutional constitutional overview identifies substantive legislation through the House and Governor assent, approval of public expenditure, government scrutiny and committees. This is the territorial Parliament, not a municipal council. The official site uses Parliament while retaining House of Assembly terminology in its constitutional explanation. Evidence: https://www.parliament.gov.tc/constitutional-overview
British Overseas Territory; a separate map parent and UK search association do not classify it as a UK administrative subdivision.

The current official Parliament site and the legacy gov.tc/hoa/videos route both designate @TCIParliament. A 16 October 2026 sitting decoded at 640x360. The 22 October event was labelled Live and decoded at 854x480 with advancing playback, but the sampled position was behind the live edge; treat this as provider-live-event/DVR validation, not proof of real-time chamber activity. Committee-room coverage remains unverified.
Added with flag, localized territorial name, UK search association, map outline and planned calendar link.
